name: I. HISTORICAL GENESIS — A NEW ERA
description:
I. HISTORICAL GENESIS — A NEW ERA is the first chapter of a monumental digital chronicle inscribed directly on the Litecoin blockchain.

Across 15 works, the collection traces the birth and evolution of a cryptographic republic — from the Genesis Spark and the rise of independent miners to the battles over scalability, privacy, institutional recognition, and cultural expansion.

Each piece is permanently inscribed onchain as an immutable historical artifact, forming a visual record within Litecoin itself.

Created in a hybrid visual language merging American monumentalism, science-fiction minimalism, and mid-poly geometry, the collection presents blockchain not merely as technology, but as architecture, law, labor, energy, and collective memory.

15 inscriptions.
One historical chapter.
The beginning of a republic of code.

Authored by Arctavis.

I. HISTORICAL GENESIS — A NEW ERA is the first part of a three-part onchain series:

I. HISTORICAL GENESIS — A NEW ERA
II. DIGITAL FOSSILS
III. AMERICAN SYMBOLS OF INNOVATION
